messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
😂😂 haba sai kace ana hauka shine wallai Nigeria an raina matasa yoh dan shekara 71 daya kamata ace yana jiran mutuwarsa come n see😩😂

output.original_text: 😂😂 haba sai kace ana hauka shine wallai Nigeria an raina matasa yoh dan shekara 71 daya kamata ace yana jiran mutuwarsa come n see😩😂

output.sadness: 😂😂 Haba, kamar ana hauka ne, wallahi Nigeria ta raina matasa, yoh, dan shekara 71 yana jiran mutuwarsa... Come n see, mai zafi 😩.
output.fear: 😂😂 Haba, sai ka ga ana hauka, wallahi Nigeria ta raina matasa, yoh, dan shekara 71 yana jiran mutuwarsa, wannan yana da ban tsoro! Come n see 😨.
output.anger: 😂😂 Haba, sai ka ga ana hauka, wallahi Nigeria ta raina matasa, yoh, dan shekara 71 yana jiran mutuwarsa! Ya kamata a yi wani abin a cikin wannan! Come n see! 😡
output.surprise: 😂😂 Haba, ga ka dai, ana hauka shine, wallahi wannan Nigeria ta raina matasa! Yoh, dan shekara 71 yana jiran mutuwarsa? Come n see! 😲😂
output.disgust: 😂😂 Haba, kai, ana hauka ne, wallahi Nigeria ta raina matasa, yoh, dan shekara 71 yana zaune yana jiran mutuwarsa? Me ya sa hakan ya zama?! Come n see! 🤢
